QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (memory_buffer_alloc.c:566–600) ... installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free` through the same setter. With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it installs the `_mutexed` wrappers, which lock a mutex around each call"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the init function installs mutexed wrappers under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and, by implication, the plain pair otherwise. It doesn't say the choice is made at compile time.
